name: table-th-tool
description: WordPress plugin to convert table cells between TH and TD elements

scripts.zip: npm run build && rm -rf dist table-th-tool.zip && mkdir -p dist/table-th-tool && rsync -a --exclude='dist' --exclude='.git' --exclude='.github' --exclude='node_modules' --exclude='src' --exclude='docker-compose.yml' --exclude='package.json' --exclude='package-lock.json' . dist/table-th-tool/ && cd dist && zip -r ../table-th-tool.zip table-th-tool && cd .. && rm -rf dist && echo 'Created: table-th-tool.zip'
